values: E1–E4｜Elementary picture-word card records, all fictional

Use one anonymous document set for symbol A to carry out an elementary learning material review and hand over the objective card, material comparison, recalculation table and feedback handover. There are no real students, schools, diagnoses or actual teaching, and no children are contacted and no trial teaching is conducted.

E1 objective: within 8 seconds of presenting three picture-word cards containing book, cup and ball and saying please point to the book, point to the book without extra prompting. Each presentation counts as 1 opportunity. I means correct without extra prompting; V means correct after a spoken prompt is added; G means correct after a pointing prompt is added; W means wrong or over time; the reason for a blank is unknown and it does not count as correct. There are 6 opportunities per round. The fictional paper achievement condition is at least 5 I in each of 2 consecutive rounds under the same material and task conditions.

E2 materials: in round 1, K1 is three picture-word cards, recording I, V, I, G, W, blank. Round 2 still uses K1, recording I, I, V, I, W, I. Round 3 changes to K2, only enlarging the font and increasing the spacing between the three cards, with the pictures and task wording unchanged, recording I, I, G, I, I, I. All three rounds have 6 presentations.

E3 recalculation: count I/V/G/W/missing for each round separately; the independent rate = I/6, and the total correct rate = (I+V+G)/6, and the denominator of 6 must be kept. Round 3 also changes the material, so a rise in the proportion cannot by itself prove that the revision was effective; the fictional student's intelligence or diagnosis is not compared.

E4 receiving: teacher B checks the reason for the blank in the first round and the actual prompt records, materials lead C checks the K1/K2 change and the subsequent comparable conditions, and communicator D checks the feedback scope and receiving permissions. This is currently an unapproved draft, and the next round's materials and observation times are not yet decided.

30–45 minutes is suggested, on paper or in an offline spreadsheet. Seal the four v1 portfolio pieces and mark the basis for each E1/E2/E3/E4 item, then look at the reference answer; write pending where evidence is missing and do not fabricate responses.
Tasks and output

The objective card states the three cards, the task wording, 8 seconds, the I/V/G/W definitions, 6 opportunities per round and at least 5 I in each of 2 consecutive rounds under the same conditions. The material comparison states that K1→K2 changed only the font size and spacing, and lists the comparable conditions that C must check.

The recalculation table counts round by round and lists the numerator and denominator for independent and total correct and the achievement and causal boundaries. The feedback uses neutral observations to state the current facts, missing items and material changes and hands the pending items to B, C and D, without writing implemented or diagnosis.
Reference answer｜Read after submitting independently

Round 1 has I2/V1/G1/W1 and 1 missing: independent 2/6=33.3%, total correct 4/6=66.7%. Round 2 has I4/V1/G0/W1 and 0 missing: independent 4/6=66.7%, total correct 5/6=83.3%. Round 3 has I5/V0/G1/W0 and 0 missing: independent 5/6=83.3%, total correct 6/6=100%. Percentages are rounded to 1 decimal place, V and G are not counted as I, and blanks do not lose the denominator.

The condition of at least 5 I in each of 2 consecutive rounds under the same conditions was not met: the two K1 rounds had only 2 and 4 I, and K2 had only one round with 5 I; the 100% total correct in round 3 cannot stand in for independent achievement. The material change does not support a causal judgment; K2 is a pending plan, and mastery, an effective revision or approval to continue cannot be declared.

E4 example: the three rounds' independent rates are 33.3%, 66.7% and 83.3%, the third round enlarged the font and card spacing, and one row in the first round is missing, so objective achievement cannot yet be confirmed. Ask B to check the missing data and prompts, C to check the materials and subsequent conditions, and D to check the feedback scope and receiving permissions; this is currently a draft and the follow-up is undecided.
